title: Discharge, father's death and returning to the Canary Cottage
summary: Spikes leaves the Army right after Armistice, his father dies, and the band is released in February to resume at the Canary Cottage in San Francisco.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh. So, how long, altogether, were you in the service?
About September, and the war was over in October, I think, or November or something like that but you couldn't

get out...we didn't get out until February. But my father, at that time, got very sick, and they turned me loose right after Armistice, which was November the eleventh. I came home about November the twelfth or something. My father died around the twentieth or something, and then, in February, they turned the rest of them loose, and we had a job waiting for us. We just wired up to 'Frisco and we had a job waiting for us on the beach called the Canary Cottage, and we--as soon as they got out--we went right on back to work to the Canary Cottage. The same band.
